hypotheses.reasoning: Redis was restarted after a node replacement and came back with 0 keys (#68). The miss ratio rose to 95% (#69), so every request went to postgres. Postgres then hit connection and CPU saturation (#74) and slow orders queries (#75). order-service queries timed out (#84), which caused the gateway 504s. This is a cache stampede: the trigger was small and the system's own reaction amplified it.
The card processor connection reset (#33) happened earlier. It is isolated and unrelated to the order-service timeouts.

verdict.recommendedAction: Warm the redis cache and rate-limit or coalesce cache-miss loads to postgres. Add single-flight request coalescing and persistence (RDB/AOF) for redis. Watch postgres connections until they recover.
